FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What are credits and how do they work? +

Credits are the currency used to process videos on Subclip. Each feature (captions, dubbing, clipping) consumes a specific amount of credits based on video length and resolution. The Creator plan refreshes 600 credits every month, while Pay as You Go gives you 4,000 credits that never expire.

Can I cancel my subscription anytime? +

Yes! You can cancel your Creator subscription at any time from your account dashboard. Your access continues until the end of the billing period and you won't be charged again.

How accurate is the AI voice cloning? +

Our AI voice cloning achieves over 95% similarity to your original voice. It captures your tone, pace, and unique vocal characteristics to deliver dubbed content that sounds authentically like you in any language.

What video formats and lengths are supported? +

Subclip supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and WebM files up to 4K resolution. Video length can range from 30 seconds to 4 hours. Longer videos will consume more credits proportionally.

Is there an API available for developers? +

Yes! Creator and Pay as You Go plans include API access. You can automate your video processing pipeline, integrate Subclip into your own apps, and build custom workflows. Documentation is available in the API section.
